about: A school of small biting fish.

prompts.text: A school of small biting fish gives underwater, rapid soft clicking and nibbling, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A school of small biting fish lets out underwater, a frantic churning thrash of many small fish, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A school of small biting fish underwater, a sharp splashy flutter, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A school of small biting fish gives a long fading dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A school of small biting fish: underwater, many tiny teeth biting, fast crunching nibbles, four separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater, a school of small fish darting past, well spaced and distinct. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
